purpose: Plan the year; teach １月/３月/５月/１つ/７月/日間/９月/２つ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 年間のイベント計画を立てましょう。
lines.en: Let’s draw up the yearly event plan.
lines.style: proactive planner opening the meeting, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: まず１月に新年フェアをやろう。
lines.en: First, a New Year fair in January.
lines.style: decisive manager proposing the opener, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ３月には卒業シーズンの催しを。
lines.style: planner mapping the spring slot, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ５月の連休は、大きな１つの目玉企画を。
lines.en: For May’s holidays, one big flagship plan.
lines.style: manager emphasizing the centerpiece, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ７月は夏祭り、二日間の開催にしましょう。
lines.en: July is the summer festival — let’s run it two days.
lines.style: planner detailing the summer event, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ９月には文化イベントを２つ並べたいね。
lines.en: In September I’d like two cultural events side by side.
lines.style: ambitious manager expanding the fall, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 季節ごとに１つずつ、目玉を作りましょう。
lines.en: Let’s make one highlight per season.
lines.style: planner proposing a clean structure, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 準備期間も、各回三日間は欲しいな。
lines.en: I’d want at least three days of prep each time.
lines.style: practical manager allowing lead time, tone holding steady through the whole line
